map.1 型或胰岛素治疗的 2 型糖友，按当前血糖、目标血糖、碳水与活性胰岛素计算餐时: For people with type 1 or insulin-treated type 2 diabetes, compute the mealtime dose from current blood glucose, target blood glucose, carbohydrates and active insulin.
map.用胰岛素‑碳水比(ICR)与校正因子(ISF)把「吃多少、血多高」转为精确单位。: Use the insulin-to-carbohydrate ratio (ICR) and the correction factor (ISF) to turn "how much was eaten, how high the glucose is" into precise units.
map.避免叠加活性胰岛素导致迟发低血糖，需扣除体内残留。: Avoid stacking active insulin and causing delayed hypoglycemia; the amount remaining in the body must be deducted.
map.个体差异大，须由内分泌科据血糖日志个体化调整，本工具只是按既定系数计算: Individual variation is large and adjustment must be individualized by an endocrinologist using glucose logs; this tool only calculates with the given coefficients
map.本工具用「活性胰岛素(IOB)」抵扣，原则同胰岛素泵的计算，居家手算也应先估算残: This tool deducts "active insulin (IOB)", the same principle used by insulin pumps; even when calculating by hand at home, first estimate what remains before adding a dose
map.ICR 和 ISF 怎么定？: How are ICR and ISF set?
map.ICR（胰岛素‑碳水比）常用 500/1800 法则估算（500÷每日胰岛素总量: ICR (insulin-to-carbohydrate ratio) is often estimated with the 500/1800 rule (500 divided by the total daily insulin gives roughly grams per unit); ISF is about 100 divided by the total daily dose x 18 (mmol scale). Individual variation is large and adjustment must be individualized by an endocrinologist using glucose logs; this tool only calculates with the given coefficients.
map.速效胰岛素作用可持续 3–4 小时，若上一次剂量仍活性就直接追加，会叠加致严重低: Rapid-acting insulin can last 3-4 hours; if the previous dose is still active and another is added straight away, the overlap can cause severe hypoglycemia. This tool deducts "active insulin (IOB)", the same principle used by insulin pumps; even when calculating by hand at home, first estimate what remains before adding a dose.
